title: unknown residentKey value with requireResidentKey true makes a discoverable passkey

unsafe.definition: a passkey stored for rp-a.test that the page never received (e.g. the create resolved with an error after storing)

note: L3 §5.4.4/§5.4.6: an unknown residentKey value is ignored, so requireResidentKey=true applies (required); the passkey must then be found by a get with empty allowCredentials.
